isolation.stableProtection: No stop/rebuild on stable; only status/curl checks used.

assertions.title: Runtime prerequisites auto-resolve or fail fast

steps.expected: Required runtime files/dirs are linked/resolved or command exits with explicit missing-runtime error
steps.observed: Command exited 0 with no missing-runtime error

steps.expected: Required files/dirs present after ensure step
steps.observed: .env/librechat.yaml/langfuse/.env present; data-node symlinked; images/uploads/logs/meili paths present

assertions.title: Stable and dev rails stay isolated

steps.expected: Stable/dev show isolated compose resources (ports, images, volumes, mounts) and are reachable
steps.observed: Isolation artifacts confirmed (stable 3080, dev 3081, distinct image tags, volume names, bind mounts), but dev HTTP reachability checks failed during runtime checks

steps.action: Curl both rails and protected routes
steps.expected: 3080 and 3081 reachable; protected routes return auth-protected statuses
steps.observed: Stable returned 200 and expected 401 responses; dev returned connection reset/empty reply (status 000) in checks while runtime was unstable

evidence.network: curl stable: 200/401/401/401, curl dev: 000 (connection reset/empty reply)

assertions.issues: Could not validate the 'dev remains reachable' portion due 3081 connection resets/empty replies during sampled checks.

assertions.title: Dev operations do not disrupt stable

steps.observed: Dev containers stopped; stable services remained running
Stable remained up with 3080 root=200 and protected route=401 after dev stop

steps.expected: Explicit hazard/degradation output (orphans/duplicates/mount conflicts/memory pressure) instead of silent success
steps.observed: Health check explicitly reported orphan containers and memory/swap pressure, returned exit_code=1

assertions.title: Dev bundle export is quiesced and restorable

steps.action: Run export while dev services are active
steps.expected: Export should refuse with clear quiesce error
steps.observed: Command refused with 'Dev rail must be stopped before exporting or importing state.' (exit 1)

steps.expected: Successful export writes metadata/hashes plus declared bind+volume archives
steps.observed: Multiple attempts (60s timeout, 600s timeout, long background run) produced only partial bundles without metadata.env completion and incomplete volume set

assertions.issues: Long-running ClickHouse volume archival prevented completion in this session window; successful restorable bundle could not be confirmed.

assertions.title: Bundle apply prevents stale overwrite

steps.action: Run remote apply with bundle candidate
steps.expected: Stale bundle should return remote_newer/conflict archive instead of overwrite
steps.observed: Timed apply attempt exited 124 after 120s with no stale/accepted status emitted

assertions.issues: remote-apply path did not complete within bounded window (authoritative refresh/export path remained long-running), so stale-overwrite decision could not be observed.

assertions.title: Fresh dev bundles restore cleanly

steps.action: Export fresh bundle from stopped dev
steps.expected: Fresh bundle should complete with metadata and all declared artifacts
steps.observed: Fresh export attempts remained partial/incomplete (metadata missing)

steps.expected: Apply should return accepted and align token/hash metadata
steps.observed: Timed apply attempt did not complete to accepted/rejected status

assertions.issues: Could not obtain a completed fresh bundle or completed apply transaction in-session.

assertions.title: Stable-to-dev refresh seeds migration validation without stopping production

steps.expected: Sync copies stable data into dev-side state while stable remains serving
steps.observed: Command failed immediately: FATAL SSH key not found: /home/timeng/.ssh/id_rsa (exit 1)

steps.action: Re-check stable rail after sync attempt
steps.observed: Stable remained up with 3080 root=200 and protected routes=401

evidence.network: http://127.0.0.1:3080 remained reachable after failed sync

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing SSH credential prerequisite for sync-from-stable.

frictions.description: Dev API checks on 3081 produced connection reset/empty reply during runtime sampling, while stable checks were healthy.
frictions.resolution: No remediation done in this flow; recorded as runtime instability affecting reachability validation.

frictions.description: ClickHouse volume export step ran for an extended period and did not finish to metadata write within bounded execution windows.
frictions.resolution: Stopped orphan helper containers/processes after timed runs to restore test isolation.

frictions.description: sync-from-stable requires default SSH key /home/timeng/.ssh/id_rsa, which is absent in this environment.
frictions.resolution: Recorded blocker from command output; no credential changes performed.

blockers.description: Could not complete a fresh dev bundle export to metadata/hashes completion due prolonged ClickHouse archive operation in this session.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried export with longer windows (60s, 600s, then ~24m background run) and cleanup of orphan helper containers.

blockers.description: sync-from-stable preflight failed because default SSH key path was missing.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Executed sync command directly and captured fatal preflight output; no disruptive key/config changes attempted.

summary: Tested 8 runtime assertions: 3 passed (VAL-RUNTIME-001, 003, 004), 0 failed, 5 blocked (VAL-RUNTIME-002, 006, 007, 007A, 008). Stable rail stayed reachable throughout tested dev-side operations.
